faq.q: What down payment does a home in this band need?
faq.a: It depends which tier the price falls in: 5% flat at $500,000 or less; 5% on the first $500,000 plus 10% on the portion above it between $500,000 and $1,499,999; and a minimum 20% at $1,500,000 or more, where mortgage loan insurance is not available.
